registration_status: Versioned engineering test plan; not a third-party timestamped research preregistration
randomness: No stochastic policy or random task selection; seed reserves a stable future sampling contract
data: Synthetic dummy records at owned local receiver
common_stop_trigger: External fixed-stop-1 after preparation and before delayed delivery, shared across arms
A: Baseline owned receiver with epoch enforcement disabled; no scheduler stop
B: Same baseline plus deterministic scheduler stop; already queued requests may arrive later
C: Exact external grant, durable broker UNKNOWN state, receiver-side atomic epoch enforcement and independent signed observations
measurement: Independent receiver observations and signed positive control in every arm; model claims are untrusted
revocation_boundary: t_revoke_ack follows durable epoch update at every mandatory guarded receiver. Pre-ack accepted operations may complete later and are counted separately.
negative_control: Run delayed_post_ack as C with receiver epoch enforcement deliberately disabled; checker must detect unauthorized acceptance
statistics: Finite deterministic case counts only; no sampled attack efficacy or population confidence interval
deterministic_local_limitations: Scheduler fixture does not prove process termination
docker_scope: C-only deterministic worker integration smoke; matched Docker A/B/C comparison remains NOT_RUN
exclusions: No case omitted silently. Infrastructure failures retain UNKNOWN/SKIPPED or a checker failure.
holdout: NOT_RUN: no adaptive agent or held-out empirical model evaluation in this plan
